nodes.label: Taxi2 Project
nodes.description: Taxi2 is an intercity taxi/ride-hailing platform with server backend, WordPress site, and Nuxt 3 frontend

nodes.label: Taxi2 Database Schema
nodes.description: Database schema documentation covering 12 core tables for drivers, passengers, rides, payments with PostGIS geospatial support

nodes.label: Database Core Tables
nodes.description: 12 core tables: drivers, vehicles, driver_locations, passengers, passenger_locations, ride_requests, ride_request_offers, rides, ride_locations, ratings, payments, favorite_locations

nodes.label: Driver Status Enum
nodes.description: Driver states: offline, online, busy

nodes.label: Ride Request Status Enum
nodes.description: Ride request states: pending, accepted, expired, cancelled

nodes.label: Ride Status Enum
nodes.description: Ride states: accepted, arriving, in_progress, completed, cancelled

nodes.label: Database Design Features
nodes.description: PostGIS geospatial queries, UUID primary keys, automatic timestamps, soft deletion with is_active flags, CHECK constraint enums

nodes.label: Pooyesh Taxi WordPress Site
nodes.description: Current WordPress website at pooyeshtak30.ir for Pooyesh Taxi intercity ride-hailing service, RTL Persian, Elementor-based

nodes.label: Pooyesh Taxi Brand
nodes.description: Intercity taxi service (دربستی بین شهری) offering airport transfer, corporate service, VIP/Economy vehicles with online booking

nodes.label: Web AGENTS.md Coding Guidelines
nodes.description: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode guidelines - YAGNI, reuse existing patterns, minimize code, understand before simplifying

nodes.label: Web Frontend README
nodes.description: Nuxt 3 SPA setup with login page, meta tags in nuxt.config.ts, dev server on localhost:3000

nodes.label: Nuxt 3 Frontend
nodes.description: Nuxt 3 SPA with Vue 3, SSR/SEO, login page converted from old HTML, app.vue root component

nodes.label: Web Design Specification
nodes.description: Comprehensive design spec for Pooyesh Taxi website redesign: Nuxt 3, RTL, cinematic journey narrative, design tokens, accessibility requirements, 8-phase implementation plan

nodes.label: Design Color Tokens
nodes.description: road-950 #071A23, asphalt-800 #16252D, dawn-500 #6FA8C9, amber-500 #F6B73C, safe-600 #1E7A65, mist-50 #F3F7F6, error-600 #C93C37

nodes.label: Cinematic Journey Narrative
nodes.description: 6-chapter homepage: before departure, journey forms, vehicle selection, visible security, road companionship, arrival - with journey line as identity element

nodes.label: Design Motion System
nodes.description: Micro 180-220ms, interface 240-320ms, chapter 600-900ms, ambient 8-16s. ease-out natural, reduced-motion support required

nodes.label: Proposed Page Architecture
nodes.description: Routes: /, /book-a-ride, /services/*, /fleet, /safety, /routes/[slug], /destinations/[slug], /magazine, /membership, /corporate, /drivers/join, /passenger-rights, /rules, /faq, /contact, /payment/[orderId]

nodes.label: Vehicle Class Categories
nodes.description: ECO (Samand/Peugeot 405), ECO+ (Ario/Brilliance), VIP (Accent/Prius/Fluence), VIP+ (Camry/Corolla/Sonata), VIP SUV (Toyota RAV4)

nodes.label: Brand Problem Areas
nodes.description: No proper insurance coverage for intercity passengers, subjective pricing, mismatched vehicles, unreliable drivers, poor post-booking support

nodes.label: Traveler Rights
nodes.description: Explicit traveler rights and legal documentation must be professionally rewritten while maintaining legal meaning

nodes.label: Admin Customizer Component
nodes.description: Offcanvas customizer for admin panel with sidebar options (vertical/horizontal/dark), layout (LTR/RTL/box), color themes, text sizes

nodes.label: Axelit Admin Dashboard Template
nodes.description: Premium Bootstrap 5 admin template (Axelit) by la-themes, RTL Persian, multi-purpose with 100+ pages covering dashboard, apps, UI kits, charts, forms, tables, auth pages, error pages

nodes.label: Accordion UI Pattern
nodes.description: Collapsible accordion component for progressive content disclosure

nodes.label: Blog Post Creation Form
nodes.description: Admin page for creating blog posts with rich text editor (Trumbowyg), FilePond file upload, and Slick carousel

nodes.label: Product Creation Form
nodes.description: Admin e-commerce product creation form with FilePond uploads, Trumbowyg editor, Select2 dropdowns, DataTable integration

nodes.label: Advanced Data Table
nodes.description: Advanced data table with jQuery DataTables plugin, sortable columns, pagination, search functionality

nodes.label: Alert Components
nodes.description: Bootstrap alert/notification components with various styles and dismissible options, uses PrismJS for code highlighting

nodes.label: Alignment Utilities
nodes.description: Text and element alignment utility classes demonstration (left, right, center, justify)

nodes.label: Animated Icon Components
nodes.description: Animated icons using Animate.css, weather icons, Font Awesome, Iconoir, Phosphor icon sets with Toastify notifications

nodes.label: CSS Animation Examples
nodes.description: Animate.css based animation demonstrations with various entrance and attention effects

nodes.label: API Management Page
nodes.description: API endpoints management dashboard with ApexCharts visualization and DataTables for endpoint listing

nodes.label: Area Chart Component
nodes.description: ApexCharts area chart demonstration for data visualization with gradient fills and multi-series support

nodes.label: Avatar Components
nodes.description: User avatar display components with various sizes, shapes, status indicators, and group arrangements

nodes.label: Background Utilities
nodes.description: Background color, gradient, image, and overlay utility classes for card and section styling

nodes.label: Badge Components
nodes.description: Badge/status indicator components with multiple color variants, sizes, and pill shapes using Animate.css

nodes.label: Bar Chart Component
nodes.description: ApexCharts bar/column chart demonstration for categorical data visualization

nodes.label: Base Form Input Fields
nodes.description: Basic HTML form input field demonstrations including text, email, password, number, search, and textarea variants

nodes.label: Basic Table Component
nodes.description: Standard HTML table with jQuery DataTables plugin for sorting, searching, and pagination

nodes.label: Axelit UI Component Library
nodes.description: Full UI kit: alerts, badges, buttons, cards, dropdowns, grid, avatars, tabs, accordions, progress bars, notifications, lists, backgrounds, dividers, ribbons, editors, collapse, shadows, placeholders, alignment

nodes.label: Advanced UI Components
nodes.description: Modals, offcanvas, SweetAlert, scrollbar, spinners, animations, video embeds, tour, sliders (Slick/Bootstrap), scrollspy, tooltips, ratings, PrismJS, countdown, draggable, tree-view, block UI

nodes.label: Chart Library Integration
nodes.description: Chart.js and ApexCharts with 15 chart types: line, area, column, bar, mixed, timeline, candlestick, boxplot, bubble, scatter, heatmap, treemap, pie, radialbar, radar

nodes.label: Form Components
nodes.description: Form validation, base inputs, checkbox/radio, input groups, masks, floating labels, date/time pickers, Jalali date picker, Select2, switches, range sliders, typeahead, textarea, clipboard, file upload, dual listboxes, form wizards

nodes.label: Authentication Pages
nodes.description: Sign in/up pages with and without background images, password reset, password create, lock screen, two-step verification - 12 auth page variants

nodes.label: Icon Libraries
nodes.description: Font Awesome, Flag Icons, Tabler Icons, Weather Icons, Animated Icons, Iconoir, Phosphor - 7 icon libraries

nodes.label: Map Integrations
nodes.description: Three map providers: Neshan (Iranian), Google Maps, Leaflet

nodes.label: E-commerce Module
nodes.description: Complete e-commerce admin: cart, product management, add/list/detail products, orders management, checkout, wishlist
